scope: Official fixed MobileEditor.svelte (real CodeMirror) branch and original View/renderAndPlaceDiagram/PanZoomState. Not desktop Monaco and not a fake substitute: the upstream Editor.svelte selects this component for mobile. The small local container, Code/Config/Reset and zoom buttons are authored integration, not a claim that the full hosted site/Navbar/History was reproduced.

Original default six-node Christmas/shopping flowchart retained except the optional fa:fa-car prefix was removed; Car text remains. No icon font/binary/font assets or screenshots. Original CodeMirror theme and view grid are preserved; system-font fallback and controlled SVG geometry tests do not constitute pixel/native/IME/drag QA.

Original Mermaid 12.3.0 flowchart renderer and Dagre layout retained, not a new renderer. Only registration lists were narrowed to flowchart/Dagre to meet local budget. Other diagram/layout loaders, ZenUML, AI, cloud login, sharing/URL import, analytics, font/image icons and rough conversion UI are unavailable; no claim of full-format hosted Mermaid support.

Original reactive input/validation and mobile edit callbacks retained. Persistence is in-memory; URL subscription never starts. Original View queue retained with disposed guards, original state adds generation checks, panzoom adds final destroy, and render failures gain a visible local alert. A local mode state selects the original light CodeMirror theme; diagram theme config is actually supported.

Local flowchart code limited to 5000 characters/100 statements and Mermaid maxEdges 80; only flowchart/graph directions accepted. Reject active HTML tags, external URLs, click links, initialization directives and font/image icons. Config limited to 3000 chars with theme/flowchart spacing+curve/look classic/layout dagre allowlist. Strict securityLevel, no external source, htmlLabels false and unchanged host CSP are enforced before actual rendering.

Original svg2roughjs code remains emitted through renderView but rough is fixed false in this selected scene; no untested hand-drawn control is advertised. No claim of mathematical/binary-font rendering fidelity beyond the original plain-text flowchart fixture.

88 positive-emitted npm package roots with full actual license texts, plus 2 Mermaid-embedded dependency sources: js-yaml4.3.2 and patched fastdom1.0.12. 26 js-yaml source files byte-match official npm, 2 fastdom source-map modifications are recorded. Fastdom full MIT is from its shipped README; Pako embedded Zlib notices are included separately. DOMPurify uses Apache-2.0 option; Khroma actual shipped license is MIT despite absent package field.

Actual570 adaptCandidate/createPreviewLoader/default cache: 4412070 UTF16 bytes, 6 entries, below unchanged 8388608 bytes. Cache reuse on remount, missing-script all-or-nothing and error retry passed. Four natural standalone JS chunks below 700KiB; no runtime eval/Function, worker or encoded binary delivery.

Functional JSDOM tests cover real CodeMirror edit/config callbacks, six-to-three-node original SVG changes, syntax/unsafe input rejection, reset, original panzoom, hidden state retention, late control/callback exit, early/queued exit, missing root and controlled SVG failure. Full listener/task/observer ledger clears; hidden finite parsing may settle. No native/browser/screenshot attempts.

export function checkCode(code:string){if(code.length>5000)throw Error('Local scene limit: 5,000 characters');if(!/^\s*(flowchart|graph)\s+(TD|TB|BT|RL|LR)\b/.test(code))throw Error('This local scene supports the original flowchart/Dagre renderer only');if(/<\s*[a-z/]|javascript:|https?:|data:|\bclick\b|\bfa[blrs]?:|%%\s*\{|@\{[^}]*\b(img|icon)\b/i.test(code))throw Error('External links, active HTML, font/image icons and initialization directives are unavailable in this local scene');if((code.match(/[;\n]/g)||[]).length>100)throw Error('Local scene limit: 100 statements');}
export function checkConfig(raw:string){if(raw.length>3000)throw Error('Local config limit: 3,000 characters');const config=JSON.parse(raw,(k,v)=>{if(['__proto__','constructor','prototype'].includes(k))throw Error('Unsafe config key');return v});const allowed=new Set(['theme','flowchart','look','layout']);for(const key of Object.keys(config))if(!allowed.has(key))throw Error('Local config supports theme, flowchart, look and layout only');if(config.layout&&config.layout!=='dagre')throw Error('Only the original Dagre layout is bundled');if(config.look&&config.look!=='classic')throw Error('This scene uses the classic renderer');if(config.theme&&!['default','neutral','dark','forest','neo','neo-dark','redux','redux-dark','redux-color','redux-dark-color'].includes(config.theme))throw Error('Unsupported theme');if(config.flowchart){for(const[key,v]of Object.entries(config.flowchart)){if(['nodeSpacing','rankSpacing'].includes(key)){if(typeof v!=='number'||v<10||v>150)throw Error('Spacing must be 10–150')}else if(key==='curve'){if(!['linear','basis','step','stepBefore','stepAfter','monotoneX'].includes(String(v)))throw Error('Unsupported curve')}else if(key==='htmlLabels'){if(v!==false)throw Error('HTML labels are unavailable')}else throw Error('Unsupported flowchart option')}}return config;}
